signatures.automorphism_equivalence: Bijections of Point/Line/UDir/ODir plus a group isomorphism of G preserving incidence, parallelism, dir, q, and intertwining rho.
axioms: Point/Line/Incides/Parallel satisfy the nondegenerate affine-plane axioms: unique line through two distinct points; through a point off a line exactly one parallel line; at least three noncollinear points.
dir(l)=dir(m) iff l=m or Parallel(l,m), so UDir is exactly the set of parallelism classes.
q is exactly two-sheeted: every u in UDir has exactly two preimages in ODir.
G acts faithfully on ODir.
G has a unique nonidentity element z with z^2=e (the involution is algebraically characterized, not named by an angular value).
No axiom requires rho(z) to preserve q-fibers or to be fixed-point-free.
definable_derived_structure: the unique fixed-point-free deck involution delta_q of the two-sheet cover
the action permutation rho(z) of the unique group involution

N0: unique group involution z by definition

explicitly_absent_structure: axiom equating rho(z) with the deck involution

signatures.automorphism_equivalence: Affine isomorphisms preserving K-order, N, and mu exactly. A coarser equivalence that forgets or rescales mu is explicitly weaker and exposes ambiguity.
axioms: The S4 ordered-affine axioms hold.
N is a norm: N(v)=0 iff v=0; N(a v)=|a|N(v); N(v+w)<=N(v)+N(w).
Poly contains all nondegenerate convex polygons definable by finite vertex lists and is closed under the finite unions/intersections needed for valuation.
mu is translation invariant, finitely additive where valuation is defined, positive on nondegenerate polygons, and homogeneous mu(aC)=a^2 mu(C) for a>0.
No normalization axiom couples the scale of mu to N.
definable_derived_structure: polygonal perimeter as sum of edge norms

ambiguity: mu -> c mu rescales the scalar role while preserving the S4+N reduct

models: Two-dimensional normed vector torsors with any compatible positive homogeneous polygon valuation.
